ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 6.1.2 Pronunciation and Enunciation ● Sounds: Double cons and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
